encounters.cc: 4-day-old male with jaundice and poor feeding

lines: 4-day-old male with jaundice and poor feeding
A 4-day-old male infant is brought to the pediatrician by his concerned parents due to jaundice and poor feeding.
The infant was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy and delivery.
The mother reports that the infant seemed well at birth but has become increasingly lethargic and irritable over the past two days.
He has also been vomiting after feeds.

lines: 6-month-old with persistent rash and frequent episodes of bleeding from the gums

They also note that the infant has had multiple episodes of otitis media over the past few months, which were treated with antibiotics.

Since his last encounter in Hematology & Oncology 3 months ago, his parents have noticed that he has become increasingly lethargic and less interactive.
He no longer smiles responsively or rolls over as he used to, and he has lost interest in toys and faces.
They also report that he startles easily to loud noises and has been having difficulty with sucking during feeds.
